purpose: Freeze, append-only, the narrow authority to run the repository's own canonical generator (pnpm b0:observation:generate, scripts/b0-observation-sql.ts) and commit its output for the single protected path db/prepared/checkpoint-b0/observation.sql, on the new successor branch codex/product-commercial-v1-pr-r1, pinned to source checkpoint 8ef40792b77b36e2688f4f00aaa16ba606f11628 (codex/product-main-integration-r1). This closes a proven-preexisting deterministic CI failure identified by the focused delta audit of that checkpoint: db/prepared/checkpoint-b0/observation.sql was hand-frozen before migration 0045_fib_domain_object_version_lineage.sql added public.domain_object_versions to the corpus, so the generator (which derives one row-count arm per table via deriveExpectedBaselineState) now produces byte-different output than the committed file. pnpm b0:observation:verify fails with 'DIVERGED from the corpus', and tests/hosted/checkpoint-b0.test.ts fails its two assertions that the committed SQL equals the freshly-built SQL and contains one row-count arm per expected table (2 of 31 tests). This addendum authorizes closing that drift by regeneration only.
scope_note: APPEND-ONLY AUTHORITY. Does not rewrite, supersede, reinterpret or restate ODS_V1_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json, ODS_V1_MAINTENANCE_ADDENDUM_v1.0.1 through v1.0.7, ODS_V1_OPERATIONAL_CLOSURE_v1.0.0.json, ODS_V1_EFFICIENCY_VALIDATION_v1.0.0.json, or any FIB/PC-01B/IM-01B artifact. HPO-ODS-W2-01 through W2-06 are FROZEN_UNCHANGED. Touches exactly one generated file inside db/prepared/** (db/prepared/checkpoint-b0/observation.sql) plus two mechanically-required companion changes: (1) registering the new grant in scripts/ods-scope.ts's PROTECTED_GRANTS registry (the pre-existing gate mechanism established by HPO-ODS-W2-01; adding an entry there is how any protected-path authority becomes machine-enforceable, not a widening of what that mechanism does), and (2) extending the closed-world enumeration assertion in tests/ods/ods-scope.test.ts ('the frozen registry contains exactly the HPO-ODS-W2-01 grant, unchanged, plus the successor HPO-ODS-W2-02 and HPO-ODS-W2-03 grants') to also describe the now-real fourth entry — every existing assertion in that test is preserved byte-for-byte; only a new block mirroring the existing per-grant assertion shape is appended and the total-count expectation is updated from 3 to 4, matching the same pattern used when HPO-ODS-W2-02 and HPO-ODS-W2-03 were themselves added to this same enumeration. This is not test weakening: no assertion is deleted, loosened, or skipped, and the test continues to fail if any grant's shape drifts undetected. No runtime code, no db/migrations/**, no db/baseline/**, and no schema is touched.

HPO-ODS-W2-07.title: GOVERN_B0_OBSERVATION_PROBE_CANONICAL_REGENERATION
HPO-ODS-W2-07.rule: On branch codex/product-commercial-v1-pr-r1 only, running `pnpm b0:observation:generate` and committing its output to db/prepared/checkpoint-b0/observation.sql is authorized. The regeneration must be produced solely by the canonical generator (scripts/b0-observation-sql.ts) — no hand-edit of the SQL file. Exactly one path is authorized under this grant: db/prepared/checkpoint-b0/observation.sql. Two mechanically-required companion changes follow from registering that grant: (1) an entry in scripts/ods-scope.ts's PROTECTED_GRANTS array (branch-scoped to codex/product-commercial-v1-pr-r1, pattern db/prepared/checkpoint-b0/observation.sql), since that file is otherwise unconditionally protected by DEFAULT_PROTECTED_PATTERNS' db/prepared/**; and (2) the additive update to tests/ods/ods-scope.test.ts's closed-world PROTECTED_GRANTS-enumeration test described in scope_note, purely to keep that test's own claim ("the registry contains exactly N grants") true rather than falsified by the new, legitimately-authorized entry.
HPO-ODS-W2-07.non_vacuity_requirement: Post-regeneration, pnpm b0:observation:verify must exit 0 (byte-identical regeneration), tests/hosted/checkpoint-b0.test.ts must go from 2 failed / 31 to 0 failed / 31, and a disposable mutation that removes or corrupts the newly-required public.domain_object_versions row-count arm must cause b0:observation:verify or the checkpoint test to fail again for that specific reason (proving the fix is real and not a vacuous pass) — the mutation must not be committed.
